purpose: Make native Git a first-class on-demand revalidation executor by preparing and pinning an immutable candidate commit before execution admission.
executionSemantics: Prepare the candidate on an isolated branch from the exact signed source head.
Candidate preparation never changes the watched deployment branch.
Before fast-forward, verify the watched branch still equals baseHeadSha.
Execution may only fast-forward the configured watched branch from baseHeadSha to candidateCommitSha.
Railway must report terminal SUCCESS for candidateCommitSha before health evidence is accepted.
Health, runtime provenance, signed source-head attestation and release admission must converge on candidateCommitSha before completion.
invariants: Candidate commit SHA is immutable after recording.
Candidate repository, branch and trigger path must match the approved native Git executor profile.
Candidate base head must match the live revalidation source head at preparation and admission.
Executor selection must remain native_git from approval through admission.
A changed branch head, authority, deployment identity, source fingerprint or executor selection invalidates admission.
No candidate record performs a branch update or Railway mutation.
Browser roles receive no table access or function EXECUTE grants.
The execution ledger rejects native-Git start evidence when the observed watched-branch head differs from the admitted base SHA.

fastForwardGuard.rule: observedBranchHeadSha must equal the admitted requiredBranchBaseSha and candidateCommitSha must equal admitted expectedSourceHeadSha
